Prospect: VelaForge Analytics — product analytics/observability for developer platforms. Mid-market, multi-tenant SaaS. Primary ask: agentic customer support assistant that can perform multi-step workflows (search docs -> open incident -> trigger remediation action).

Deal context: evaluating Hosted API first (fast ramp, see streaming/tool-calling behavior) with intention to move to Dedicated if we can meet latency SLOs and predictable cost. Team concerned about tool-call reliability and timeouts when agent must call internal tools (search, ticketing, deploy hooks).

Key quotes: "If the tool-call times out we break the conversation — need deterministic fallback & idempotency guarantees." — CTO Ana Morales.

POC scope discussed: 1) Streaming chat with tool calling (search + create-ticket) on sample tenant, 2) Instrumented metrics for tool-call latency and success rate, 3) Failure modes: timeouts -> fallback prompts + human escalation, 4) Cost baseline for 250k msgs/month.

Security notes: require SSO/SAML, KMS integration (customer-managed keys preferred), audit logging for all tool calls, and EU data residency for EU customers. Legal sent initial questionnaire (refer drive doc).

Commercial: Interested in a pricing band model for Dedicated (committed throughput) after 8-week POC. Procurement timeline: Q2 decision if POC meets SLOs.
